items.text: Search & modal focus — shortcuts >, *, and ! move keyboard focus into the search panel or app modal (cheat sheet / recent bookmarks) instead of leaving it on the bookmark grid. Tab stays trapped inside the open overlay.

Tag cloud, page overview & omnibox — the same focus and background-inert treatment now applies to the tag word cloud (/), page overview (,), and quick-add omnibox (&). The dashboard grid is not clickable behind an open overlay; closing any overlay restores mouse and keyboard access.
Move/delete/tag popover inert — Shift+M / Shift+D / Shift+T, the category date popover, and inline edit now sync dashboard inert and pause grid selection while open, matching search and modals.

Inert sync — dashboard inert follows open overlays from the DOM (search, app modal, tag cloud, page overview, omnibox, move/delete popovers, inline edit) instead of a fragile ref-count, so repeated open/close cycles no longer leave the grid stuck non-interactive.

Grid shortcuts restored — ; (inline edit), Shift+M (quick move), Shift+D (quick delete), and Shift+T (quick tag) work again while keyboard-navigating bookmarks; search no longer swallows shift-modified letter keys meant for the grid or reopens while those popovers are active.

G shortcuts vs G+jump — a quick tap on G opens bookmark shortcuts that start with G (e.g. g, ga, g1). Hold G (~300 ms) or press G then a digit / P / a second G for category jump, pinned jump, or GG as before.
Escape with promos — dismissing a one-time Got it balloon no longer blocks Esc from closing page overview or omnibox underneath.

Quick-tag popover (Shift+T) — beside the keyboard-selected bookmark; ranked tags with ✓ on tags already applied. ↑/↓ navigate; Enter/Space toggle a tag and advance to the next for batch tagging. Dashboard stays inert while the popover is open.
Tag popover focus — keyboard focus lands on the tag list (aria-activedescendant); grid arrows are blocked; Shift+T is detected reliably via KeyT in capture phase.
Quick-tag discoverability — first Shift+T may show a one-time Got it balloon beside the tag popover; reset from Tours & onboarding.
Action popover selection restore — closing Shift+M / Shift+D / Shift+T popovers restores keyboard highlight and focus on the same bookmark row instead of jumping to the first row on the page.
Command palette Enter — Enter / Space on a highlighted command row runs it again after autocomplete (e.g. :button groups); a stale guard no longer swallows the next confirmation.

Filters in search mode — category:, tag:, page:, and status: work in > search with autocomplete chips. A lone : still opens command mode; with text already in the bar, : inserts filter syntax instead of switching modes.

Filter autocomplete — status:, tag:, and page: show value suggestions after you pick a filter hint (including when the query ends with a space after the colon). Only one expandable Filters group appears — no duplicate headers.
Partial filter typing — while you type values such as status:on or page:cu, autocomplete stays visible instead of applying a half-finished filter or flooding the list with shortcuts.
status: filters — online/offline/checked filters use fresh bookmark data from the current page and persisted reachability (lastChecked, status cache), not stale copies from the global pool.
Live command palette — after Enter, toggle and view commands keep the palette open; labels refresh with (on)/(off), ✓, or a brief flash — no toast spam.

10 command groups — lone : shows collapsible groups (add & remove, edit, open & inspect, search, navigation, layout, display, smart collections, tag filter, system). Click a header to expand completions.
Bookmark & navigation commands — :move, :edit, :copy, :category, :page, :open pinned/tag/category; :recent (*), :overview (,), :cheat, :add (&), :config, :reload.

Display, tools & filters — :dark, :title, :lang, :animations, :status, :opacity, :collections; :backup, :export, :metadata, :tour, :promo, :filter; :find clear, :goto config/stats/health, :health page.

Health action runtime — a new health-runtime.js layer coalesces re-renders, blocks concurrent row actions, and applies fetch timeouts so detect redirect, title refresh, delete, and favicon refresh no longer freeze or crash the page.

Detect redirect — redirect detection uses a faster redirectOnly=1 suggest call (skips title fetch), shows the proposed URL in the confirm dialog, and surfaces timeouts in the status bar instead of leaving the UI unresponsive.
Ping in overflow menu — Re-check status also appears under Status in the row More actions (⋯) menu, next to the toolbar ping button.

Health render loop — page filter and sort dropdowns no longer retrigger infinite re-renders when options are rebuilt; deferred select sync, scheduleRender(), and a render-depth guard keep the view responsive.
1-click fix removed — the primary 1-click fix button is removed from health beta. Use the overflow menu (detect redirect, refresh title, archive) for repair actions instead.
Report loading — health report fetches deduplicate while a reload is already in flight.
Onboarding finish & skip — completing step 9/9 or skipping at step 1 reliably tears down the wizard (no stuck guided-flow-locked overlay) and persists settings without hanging.

Post-onboarding spotlights — layout-versions nudge, preview-card spotlight, and config bookmarks tour receive the dashboard instance again, so classic-layout nudge and related hints can show after onboarding when eligible.

Rotating tips delay — footer shortcut tips above the action buttons wait one minute after you finish or skip first-run onboarding before they start, so post-setup prompts and What's new are not competing for attention.
Context tips on page change — footer tips refresh when you switch pages without resetting the one-minute onboarding delay or rotation timers.

Search discoverability promos — one-time Got it balloons for >, :, and ? show on the first keypress even when the grid-navigation promo is still eligible; promos no longer block each other while search is open.
Faster first paint — skeleton shimmer and category/bookmark enter animations are shorter on dashboard bootstrap so the grid feels ready sooner.
Recent modal tab caps — recent bookmarks modal and :open last plans read the 15-tab safe cap from DashboardBookmarkRows again after the module split.

Essentials on first visit — the first time you open Config → General, the Essentials layer is selected automatically. After you explicitly pick Essentials, Advanced, or Show all (including Advanced settings → jumps and settings-search navigation), that choice is remembered for later visits.

Dashboard module split — dashboard.js is now a thin orchestrator over focused modules under static/js/dashboard/ (data, render, toolbar, promos, UI helpers, …) with Playwright smoke tests for overlays, grid shortcuts (including G tap vs hold, Shift+T tag popover, and action popover selection restore), command palette, search filters (status:/tag:/page: autocomplete), recent modal tab caps, post-onboarding layout nudge, and health redirect detect.
Timer teardown — pagehide clears tip rotation, backup tip, post-onboarding, and pending bookmark-open timers so background tabs do not keep firing after navigation.

Help & manual — README, MANUAL, CHANGELOG, config help, and this release note updated for overlay focus, search filter autocomplete, health runtime and detect redirect hardening, ping in health overflow menu, removal of health 1-click fix, onboarding/tips timing, General layer defaults, grid-shortcut fixes, G hold-vs-tap bookmark shortcuts, command palette expansion (live feedback, 10 groups, 50+ commands), quick-tag popover (Shift+T), and action popover selection restore.

Cache-bust — whats-new-v88 (2026.06-dashboard-release-v69); keyboard-navigation.js / search.js (g-shortcut-hold-1, cmd-palette-live-5, shift-t-tag-4); dashboard-bookmark-rows.js (tag-popover-3); dashboard-ui-helpers.js (action-popover-select-1); health-runtime.js / health.js / health.css (health-runtime-1 / health-runtime-2); focus-trap-utils.js, and related dashboard module bundles.
